title: Why FIT people sweat MORE 💦
caption:
Training makes you sweat sooner and more, so you cool down faster and keep going longer. It's a sign of fitness. Do you sweat a lot? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #6
first_comment: Be honest: are you a heavy sweater? 💦
sources: Buono MJ, Sjoholm NT. Effect of physical training on peripheral sweat production. J Appl Physiol 1988;65:811-814 (trained: earlier onset, more sweat per gland)
Nadel ER et al. Mechanisms of thermal acclimation to exercise and heat. J Appl Physiol 1974;37:515-520
